text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To not even make the board... How careless 
of me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, my top speed will never... 
ngh!
choice_data_list:
Hanging your head is already a detour in 
itself.

Just hanging your head is already taking 
the long way around.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Indeed. That was a close call.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list:
Alright, if we're doing this, let's go all 
out!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Those who aim to be the fastest have no 
time to feel down.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What is needed is the effort to become 
faster than I am now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"If we're going to make a move, the sooner 
the better. Strike while the iron is hot, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along with a forward-leaning Calstone 
Light O, I left the racecourse with a 
renewed sense of purpose.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Retraining is exactly what I desire.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The liberating feeling of having no one 
ahead... I want to experience that 
sensation of dashing across the finish 
line in first place once more.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I will return to the path of the fastest, 
as fast as I can.
